parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Wallpaper/Tests/WallpaperTests/QualityMetricsAggregatorTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.82 indicates structurally near-duplicate test methods (`calculatesAvgShaderFPS` at line 319 and `calculatesWorkloadReduction` at line 427), each test exercises a distinct behavioural contract of `QualityMetricsAggregator` — average shader FPS vs. workload reduction — so their structural resemblance is a natural consequence of the shared test harness pattern, not unintentional duplication. Merging or extracting these into shared helpers would obscure the intent of each individual test case and couple unrelated assertions, reducing readability and debuggability of the test suite.
